name: SupaCloud application backend
rules: Use @supabase/supabase-js for user-scoped Auth, Database, Storage, Realtime, and standard Edge Function invokes.
Use @supacloud/js only in trusted server-side code for platform task, queue, workflow, command, artifact, OAuth/OIDC, or SupAuth operations.
Keep database migrations append-only. A schemas/ directory may organize current authored SQL but does not replace reviewed migrations.
Use one authoritative Supabase-compatible deployment root per application: supabase/ or an established supacloud/ root, never both.
Keep Edge Function entrypoints thin. Reserve functions/_shared for technical cross-cutting code and keep domain services with their owning API, worker, webhook, or scheduled Function.
For durable side effects, write the accepted domain change and outbox or command intent in one transaction, then dispatch from a trusted worker.
Do not expose service_role, Management API tokens, tenant database credentials, or webhook secrets to browser or mobile clients.
Treat workflow, command, and artifact ledgers as execution and audit mechanisms; application domain tables remain authoritative for business state.
verification: affected browser or runtime smoke test
